title: Downloading the area you chose
description: A box on the map sets the area, and a list shows what it contains and whether it is ready.

blocks.text: When you pan around, it is hard to tell which part of the map is already prepared for use with no network.

quote.text: meh, downloading offline maps is annoying, can’t just draw a box around a region and download, they have some janky system where you have to zoom in and pan and scan everywhere.. so if you don’t pan and scan and zoom in on a particular tile it wont save. Obviously not an Outdoorsy Off Grid person.

blocks.text: Select the area, show the zoom levels and the size, and keep the state of the parts that are unfinished. Let the finished set be checked by opening it.
A download icon is no substitute for checking that the details you need are actually available.
